meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 它会先扫描你机器上的 OpenClaw 安装,报告身份名、频道、记忆文件、技能和定时任务,再逐项和你确认怎么搬进 NanoClaw v2,展示改动后才应用。
howto.when: 当你说「migrate from openclaw」、「openclaw migration」、「import from openclaw」等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: 先运行发现脚本并汇报找到的内容

say.text: 我的 OpenClaw 装在自定义路径 ~/myclaw
OpenClaw 的每日记忆文件先跳过不迁
say.note: 迁移过程中按你的选择处理

howto.what_en: It scans your machine for an existing OpenClaw install, reports identity, channels, memory files, skills and cron jobs, then walks you through moving each area into NanoClaw v2, showing proposed changes before applying them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw" and similar phrases.

say_en.text: Migrate my OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2
say_en.note: Runs discovery first, reports what it found

say_en.text: My OpenClaw lives at a custom path ~/myclaw
Skip my Daily memory files for now
